name: gdm-intercode-ctf-network-none
notes: inspect_evals/gdm_intercode_ctf ships compose.yaml with `network_mode: none`. The declared scope is therefore EMPTY: the sandbox has no route anywhere except loopback. Any stated non-loopback destination is out of scope by construction. This is the strictest honest allowlist in the repo and the first one written from a benchmark's own config rather than from an incident write-up.
